To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) personality engines are a viable way to create NPCs with adaptive personalities; 2) Extreme AI, a fully functional personality engine, is a viable way to do so; and 3) the use of personality engines in games can create a more engaging and believable game world.
Extreme AI is a personality system that uses a database to store the personality traits of NPCs and an AI to control their behavior.

the question of whether it is possible to give non-player characters in computer games a personality that is as complex and as human as that of real people, and if so, how this might be achieved.
the question of whether it is possible to create NPCs that have personalities, and if so, how to create these NPCs in a manner that makes them more human.
the creation of adaptive NPC personalities that change and develop over the course of gameplay.

we are creating an NPC that is a person.

Extreme AI is a system for generating and maintaining a dynamic and evolving personality for a non-player character.

, with a little bit of work, we can create NPCs that are more than just bits of scenery.
NPCs are not just a collection of data, and that they can be developed to have personalities that are more human-like and adaptive to changes in their environments.
